prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Here is a quick cheat sheet for interacting with your new companion on your screen.", "Right-click pet for main menu & settings", "Double-click pet to open chat window", "Drag and drop pet anywhere on screen"]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Companion", "Confirm Desktop Visibility", "Can you see your new pet floating near the bottom-right of your screen?", "Yes, I see my pet!", "No, run display fix"]
2: ["What is your companion's vibe?", "Select traits to customize your desktop pet's behavior and aesthetic.", "Playful & Energetic", "Calm & Focused", "Continue to Selection"]
3: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt", "Pick a ready-made companion or design your own custom pet from scratch.", "Instant Adoption (Ready Pets)", "Custom Creator (Photos & AI)"]
4: ["Save Your New Companion", "Sign in to keep your selected pet synchronized across your devices.", "Your pet selection will be preserved upon sign-in."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new pet a name to finalize the adoption papers.", "Enter Pet Name", "Official Desktop Companion", "Stamp & Finalize"]
6: ["Having trouble signing in? Click below to open web authentication fallback.", "Stuck on loading? Ensure your browser permits desktop app authentication tokens."]
7: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "Tip: You can move your pet anytime by holding Shift and dragging with your mouse."]
8: ["Provide Photo for Custom Pet", "Upload a clear photo of your pet or pick a sample template for instant generation.", "Upload Your Own Photo"]
9: ["Shortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet.", "Hotkey: Ctrl + Shift + P", "Test Pet Sound"]
